message.content:
Los Angeles (Pacific Time Zone) is normally **9 hours behind** Berlin (Central European Time).  
During daylight‑saving periods the offset can shift:

| Period | Los Angeles | Berlin | Difference |
|--------|-------------|--------|------------|
| Standard time (winter) | UTC−08:00 | UTC+01:00 | –9 h |
| Daylight saving (summer) | UTC−07:00 | UTC+02:00 | –9 h |

Because both regions observe DST, the relative offset stays at 9 hours throughout the year. However, if you’re looking at a specific date near the DST transition dates (mid‑March or early‑November), the offset could temporarily change to 8 or 10 hours until the clocks adjust.
